method: Isolated native/RMS styles, RMS scripts and real EditorJS; workspace persistence and account actions are local test doubles. No authenticated account or workspace was changed.
results: Desktop uses only the sidebar toggle
Shortcut counts have enough line height and no circular clipping
Nested tooltip values and labels contrast with the dark background
Sidebar account opens locally and forwards only the chosen existing action
Editing stays in the RMS canvas with save/discard and real EditorJS tools
Save restores original widget DOM before native serialization and preserves the new order
Remove changes only the draft; Discard restores the original blocks
Add widget uses the registered EditorJS tool and Discard restores the original draft
Account popover stays within the viewport in RTL
Phone retains one panel entry and a local account menu with independent Escape behavior
